test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is not the main feature of FAME-2 India Scheme?

options.text: It plans to support 1 million electric two wheelers, 500,000 electric three wheelers, 55,000 electric four wheelers and 7000 electric buses.
Its target is only private transport vehicles
Total outlay will be Rs. 10,000 crore
It is to encourage faster adoption of electric and hybrid vehicles

solution:
The correct answer is **Its target is only private transport vehicles**

• FAME India is a part **of the National Electric Mobility Mission Plan.**
